title: F1 stepper breaks the whole form-bug-hunt E2E suite: all 57 scenarios fill fields across sections that the stepper now hides
evidence: form_stepper.js:324 "        s.el.hidden = idx !== i;" and :540 "    show(model.current(), { initial: true });". .claude/skills/form-bug-hunt/SKILL.md step 8: "Always fill the controlling field **before** filling its dependents, otherwise the dependents may be hidden and refused by Playwright." SKILL.md steps 6-7 fill/select/upload purely by `name` attribute; `grep -rni stepper .claude/skills/form-bug-hunt/` matches nothing, and all 57 scenario YAMLs contain a form_data block (verified).
detail: Initial paint hides sections 2-8; the harness fills the whole form in document order with no Continue/stepper handling, so every fill/upload past section 1 is Playwright-refused. The apply form's only E2E defense (consent, anti-fraud, whitelists) goes red, and F1 ships with no working E2E path.
recommended_fix: Teach the harness to drive the stepper (click data-testid=step-continue-<id> after each section, satisfying gating) or expose a test hook that disables it; get one canonical scenario green before merge.

title: apply-form-label-invariants.yaml fails three ways against the new UI (removed listing_source, stepper-hidden sections, hidden submit)
evidence:
Line 135: "        "job_title", "employer_name", "employment_duration", "listing_source","; the step's guard "        if (!input) { errors.push(name + ": input element not found"); continue; }"; the visibility rule "        if (wrapper.offsetParent === null) return false;"; the submit step "  - action: click
    selector: '[data-testid="submit-application"]'". The diff's own pin (form_view_test.gleam): "  html
  |> string.contains("name=\"listing_source\"")
  |> should.be_false".
detail: F4 deletes the select, so VISIBLE_OPTIONAL fails with "listing_source: input element not found". F1 hides sections 2-8 at load, so VISIBLE_REQUIRED reports the 12 required fields outside section 1 as not visible (offsetParent null), and the closing click targets a hidden submit button. Scenario not updated in this PR.
recommended_fix: Update the scenario: remove listing_source from the optional sets, make the visibility sweep stepper-aware (advance steps or run with the stepper disabled), and navigate to review_consent before the submit click.

title: Two form-bug-hunt scenarios still reference the removed listing_source select; critical smoke scenario also fills address fields now inside a closed <details>

  eircode: "H91XYZ1""; the cluster renders closed on pristine, pinned by the new test "  pristine
  |> string.contains("address-cluster\" open")

detail: The tamper scenario's inject eval throws (its premise — the select exists — is now false), and the canonical happy path fills a field the form no longer renders plus four fields hidden inside the collapsed address cluster. Neither scenario was updated alongside the F4 removal.
recommended_fix: Drop listing_source from the happy-path form_data, open the address <details> (click summary) before filling it, and rewrite the tamper scenario as a raw POST — the server whitelist it defends still exists.
